## My Projects

This page will showcase your research projects, data science work, and other professional accomplishments.

To add projects, create a `projects` directory and add `.qmd` files for each project with the following YAML front matter:

```yaml
---
title: "Project Title"
description: "Brief description of the project"
date: "2024-01-01"
---
```

You can also add project details, visualizations, and analysis directly in the project `.qmd` files using R code chunks.
